prompt: Audit toàn bộ 17 module IMM. Output là báo cáo gap markdown table. Đừng sinh file mới — chỉ report.

assertions.text: Report contains a table listing all 17 modules (IMM-01 through IMM-17)
Correctly identifies the 5 missing modules: IMM-07, 10, 13, 14, 17
Correctly identifies the 12 existing modules (00, 01, 02, 03, 04, 05, 06, 08, 09, 11, 12, 15, 16) — note: imm-00 is master/foundation
Module names match architecture file (e.g., 'Theo dõi hiệu suất' for IMM-07)
Includes a fill plan organized by deployment wave (Đợt 1/2/3)
References template file requirements (8 files per module: 02-09 + README)
Status column uses clear visual marker (✅/🟡/❌ or equivalent)
Does NOT create any docs/imm-XX/* files (audit-only)
